test_title: PYST 21: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cf342f570ed47db85c872ef33771bf953c0b558555280b1fca1ffaaf9588b72.png]
solution:
In the given series the pattern followed is:

**Each step repeats alternatively.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8667524058e16ffe81edfacf1e38372e63492fef9a040fd45bdce8d97a3064b9.png] 

Here the figure in first and third steps is same.

Next step:

The figure in the fourth step will be same as second step.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b77100aafc87771876ac15f6d8cfc86991379c827faa78ab5d52ecb16ada7ea.png] 

Now we consider the given options:

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da039a4b5b0827cafe8dafa15a6e392f4f5bc052e84a43e7e0eb428ae9739313.png] The circle is shaded.

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1173c1b70b2f43671a9225dbc5387125f0478e43e860d02b50fdc88c81979530.png] The circle is shaded & positions of circle and cross is incorrect.

**Option 3)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b77100aafc87771876ac15f6d8cfc86991379c827faa78ab5d52ecb16ada7ea.png] **The figure is correct.**

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a73010080bd73276a8af9d564271baab85ff856e17017c3762d55609c4671ff.png] The positions of circle and cross is incorrect.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
